final.title: IRS audit notice for 2016 tax return
steps: Review the enclosed Form 886-H-EIC and send documents showing your child met the relationship, age, and residency tests for the Earned Income Credit.
Review the enclosed Form 14950 and send documents showing you are entitled to claim the Premium Tax Credit.
Review the enclosed Form 886-H-HOH and send documents proving you are the head of your household.
Complete the Response form and mail or fax it with your supporting documents within 30 days from January 28, 2019.
If you cannot get your documents ready in time, call 866-xxxx-xxxx (or 800-829-1040).
final.objection: Review the enclosed Publication 3498-A (The Examination Process), which describes your appeal rights.
final.if_ignored: If you do not mail or fax your supporting documentation within 30 days from the date of this notice, the IRS will disallow the items being audited and send you an audit report showing proposed changes to your tax return, which may mean you owe additional tax plus penalties and interest.
corrected: read as "800-TAX-ORM", understood as "800-TAX-FORM" (the IRS toll-free number for tax forms and publications)

explained.title: IRS Tax Return Audit Notice
steps: Review the enclosed Form 886-H-EIC, Form 14950, and Form 886-H-HOH.
Submit the requested documentation showing your child met the relationship, age, and residency tests, and that you are the head of your household.
Mail or fax your supporting documentation and Response form within 30 days from the date of the notice.
explained.if_ignored: The IRS will disallow the items being audited, send you an audit report showing proposed changes, and you may owe additional tax, penalties, and interest.

final.title: 2023 Ohio income tax assessment notice
steps: If you agree with the assessment, pay $2,204.52 in full within 60 days after service of the notice of assessment (refer to the payment options response page; partial payments can also be made during the 60 days).

If you disagree with the assessment, file a signed written petition for reassessment within 60 days after service, either electronically at tax.ohio.gov/OHTAX or by mail to Ohio Department of Taxation, P.O. Box 182402, Columbus, OH 43218-2402.

If you are filing a petition because you failed to file a required 2023 Ohio IT 1040 return, include the return with your petition (and pay the total assessment amount if one of the listed exceptions applies).
final.objection: You have 60 days after service of the notice of assessment to file a signed written petition for reassessment online at tax.ohio.gov/OHTAX or by mail to P.O. Box 182402, Columbus, OH 43218-2402. You may also request a hearing with your timely-filed petition.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or file a petition within 60 days, the assessment becomes final and may be certified to the Ohio Attorney General's Office for collection. final.title: Notice of Motor Vehicle Registration Renewal
steps: If you live in Davidson, Hamilton, Rutherford, Sumner, Wilson, or Williamson County, complete emissions testing before renewing (visit tn.gov/revenue/renewals for locations).

Renew your registration by November 30, 2021, and pay 29.00 using one of these methods: online at tncountyclerk.com, through the app at getautoassistant.com, at a kiosk (visit tncountyclerk.com for locations), by mail (send payment and renewal notice to your local county clerk office), or in person (visit your local county clerk office with your renewal notice or current registration).
If you want to order a decal by mail, add $2.00; if you want to donate to Donor Awareness, check the Organ Donor box and add $1.00.
final.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not renew.

You can pay in person at a public finance center (centre des finances publiques) by bank card or in cash (up to 300€).

final.title: Water and sanitation bill
steps: Pay 99,52 € before January 20, 2022.

To pay by TIP (payment slip), date and sign the slip (include a RIB if requested or if your bank details changed) and mail it without folding, stapling, or taping to Centre d'encaissement des Finances publiques - 35908 RENNES CEDEX 9.
To pay by cheque, make it payable to TRESOR PUBLIC, attach the unsigned slip, and mail it to the same address.

You can also pay by card or cash at a tobacconist (buraliste) or approved partner using the QR code, or online via https://eaux.meusegrandSud.fr/ or by bank transfer to IBAN FR09 300000200020000000000000000000 (BIC POPFFRPAV).
final.objection: You can submit a claim or objection within 60 days following the invoice date.
final.if_ignored: The letter does not state what happens if you do not pay by the deadline.
corrected: read as "SG BARLE DUC", understood as "SGC de Bar-le-Duc" (the public finance collection office)
read as "meusegrandsudo.fr", understood as "meusegrandsud.fr" (the water service website)

explained.title: Water and sanitation bill
steps: Pay the amount of 99,52 € by January 20, 2022.

To pay by TIP, date and sign the payment stub and include a bank identity statement (RIB) without using staples, paperclips, tape, or folding it, and send it to the address: Centre d'encaissement des Finances publiques - 35908 RENNES CEDEX 9.
To pay by check, include the unsigned payment stub with a check payable to TRESOR PUBLIC, without using staples, paperclips, tape, or folding it.
Alternatively, pay online at www.eau-normandie.fr using your invoice number and secure login details, or scan the QR code to pay by credit card or cash at an approved tobacconist.
corrected: read as "écretement", understood as "écrétement" (capping of consumption amounts)
read as "dépôt de paiement", understood as "modalité de paiement" (payment method)

final.title: Overdue tax bill and seizure notice
steps: Pay $3,999.86 immediately, by March 12, 2009. Make your check or money order payable to the United States Treasury, and write your Social Security number (XXX-XX-XXXX), the tax year (2005), and the form number (1040) on your payment and any correspondence.

If you cannot pay the full amount, pay as much as you can now and set up a payment plan by visiting www.irs.gov (search for "opciones de pago de impuestos") or by calling 1-800-829-0922 to discuss your options.
If your address has changed, call 1-800-829-0922 or visit www.irs.gov.
final.objection: If you already paid your balance in full or believe a payment was not credited to your account, call 1-800-829-0922 with your payment information ready. You can also fill out the contact information section, detach it, and mail it with any correspondence or proof of payment.
final.if_ignored: If you do not call immediately or pay by March 12, 2009, the IRS may seize any state tax refund you are entitled to and apply it toward the $3,999.86 you owe. If you still have a balance after that, they could seize your other property and property rights.

explained.title: IRS Intent to Seize Property Notice CP504
steps: Pay the immediate amount of $3,999.86 by March 12, 2009.
Make your check or money order payable to the United States Treasury.
Write your Social Security number (XXX-XX-XXXX), the tax year (2005), and the form number (1040) on your payment and any correspondence.
If you cannot pay the full amount, pay as much as possible now and set up a payment plan online at www.irs.gov or call 1-800-829-0922.
If you believe there is an error or have already paid, call 1-800-829-0922 with your payment information ready.
explained.if_ignored: The IRS may seize any state tax refund due to you and, if a balance remains, take possession of your other property and property rights.

final.title: Proposed changes to 2006 tax return
steps: Review this notice and compare the IRS's proposed changes with your 2006 tax return.
If you agree with the changes, complete, sign, and date the Response Form on page 5 and send it with your payment of $2,289.00 so that it is received by July 16, 2008.

If you cannot pay the full amount, pay as much as you can now and send the Response Form with Form 9465(SP) to request an installment plan (download at www.irs.gov/espanol or call 1-800-829-3676), or call 1-800-829-8310 to discuss your options.
If you disagree with the changes, complete the Response Form on page 5 and send it with a signed statement and any supporting documentation so that it is received by July 16, 2008.
final.objection: If you disagree with the changes, complete the Response Form on page 5 and send it with a signed statement and all supporting documentation so that the IRS receives it by July 16, 2008.
final.if_ignored: If you do not respond by July 16, 2008, the IRS will send you a Statutory Notice of Deficiency followed by a final bill for the total amount owed. Interest will continue to increase and penalties may apply.

explained.title: Proposed changes to your 2006 tax return
steps: Review this notice and compare the IRS changes with your 2006 tax return information.
If you agree with the changes, complete, sign, and date the Response Form on page 5 and send it along with your payment of $2,289.00 so they receive it by July 16, 2008.
If you cannot pay the full amount, pay as much as you can now and submit a request for an installment payment plan using Form 9465(SP), or call 1-800-829-3676 to request a copy.
If you do not agree with the changes, complete the Response Form on page 5 and send it along with a signed statement and all supporting documentation so they receive it by July 16, 2008.
explained.if_ignored: If we do not hear from you by July 16, 2008, we will send you a Statutory Notice of Deficiency followed by a final bill for the total amount due. During this time interest will increase and penalties may apply.
